people.name: MUM
lines: Morning, sleepyhead! Professor Oak next door was asking for you.
All children leave home one day. Go on, he's waiting at the lab.

lines: Ah, there you are! I've been waiting.
Those three balls on the table: each holds a creature. One of them is yours.
Take your time choosing. It's a partner for life.
